plan.summary: Wizard'da yeni akis olusturulunca preview atlanip direkt editore yonlendirme. Editor'de AI Chat degisiklik onerdiginde canvas uzerinde Eklendi/Degisti/Silindi node isaretleri. Ayrica onceki session'dan kalan flow activate/deactivate toggle eklentisi.
plan.q_intent: akis preview olarak gostermeye gerek yok. dogrudan akisi goster. ama akis zaten var ve degisiklik yapiliyorsa o zaman eklendi, degisti, silindi gibi nodelari isaretle.

files_changed.change: Added autoConfirmPending flag and clearAutoConfirm action
Added pendingDiff map and setPendingDiff action
Added auto-confirm effect when first flow_config arrives
Added diff computation effect when pendingFlowConfig changes
Updated indicator message to reflect auto-redirect
Suppressed diff markers for brand new flows (no previousFlowPreview)
Added DiffLegend overlay component when pending diff exists
Added diffStatus subscription with ring/badge/opacity for added/modified/removed
Pre-existing: added isActive/isToggling/onToggleActive props for flow activation toggle

verification_questions.question: Does auto-confirm only fire on the FIRST flow_config (not on subsequent wizard iterations)?
Is the pendingDiff map properly cleared when pendingFlowConfig becomes null (accept or reject)?
Does the DiffLegend only appear when there are actual diff entries (not on empty map)?

intentional_exclusions: AiChatPanel.tsx text-based DiffSummary kept as-is alongside new canvas markers

user_facing_errors: Wizard store error state surfaces via existing error banner
error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Auto-confirm catch block lets wizard store error state surface to UI. confirmFlow rejection is visible.
